note: Every command is checked against data/raw/game/convars.txt + commands.txt (datamined). The game's own description from the dump is shown next to each one.

open.t: Turn on Enable Developer Console (~) in the game settings, then press the ~ key to open and close the console.
q: set Enable Developer Console (~) to Yes
the console can be opened and closed by pressing the [~] key

groups.title: Practice server (paste after creating a private match)

cmds.what: Allows the practice commands below. Only works on your own server.
Ends warmup so the round starts.
Lets you join any team.
Stops the game moving you to the other team.
No waiting at the start of a round.
Long rounds so you are not interrupted.
Raises the money cap.
Start every round rich.
Buy outside the buy zone.
Buy at any time in the round.
Your weapon never runs out of ammo.
Carry one of every grenade.
Shows where a grenade will land before you throw it.
Shows where each bullet hit (for spray practice).
Removes all bots.
Restarts the round with the settings above.
Throws your last grenade again from the same spot (bind it to a key).
Adds a T bot. Use bot_add_ct for a CT bot.
Freezes bots in place.
Bots stop shooting back.
Bots crouch (practise lower heads).
Puts a bot where you are looking.
Bots copy your movement: good for peek practice.
Draws your current spread so you can see counter-strafing work.
Shows your position and speed on screen.
You cannot die.
Fly through walls to reach lineup spots fast.
Gives you a weapon by its game name (weapon_awp, weapon_m4a1_silencer...).
Mouse sensitivity (eDPI = DPI x this).
Sensitivity while scoped.
Paste a crosshair share code after it. The game's command list flags it developmentonly, so it may not work outside a test build; the crosshair settings also take share codes.
Crosshair bar length in pixels.
Crosshair thickness in pixels.
Gap from the centre in pixels.
Centre dot on (1) or off (0).
Crosshair moves with recoil (1) or stays still (0).
Field of view of the gun model on your screen.
Stop the radar following you, so it shows more of the map.
Radar zoom: lower shows more of the map.
Radar size on screen.
Frame rate counter.
Frame rate cap (0 = no cap).
Always show your frame rate in the HUD.
Stops the use key opening the buy menu.
Records a demo of your own server.
Plays a demo file.
Opens the demo playback controls.
Jump on mouse wheel down.
Removes a bind.
Saves your settings to your config now.
